summary.result: Analysis results with descriptive analysis and negative binomial regression models indicate that physical environmental factors are more likely to be associated with pedestrian traffic accidents.
summary.background: Pedestrian traffic accidents around EMBL stations have recently become a serious problem.
summary.method: According to the data from January 2014 to April 2017, 98 cases (14%) of the 685 pedestrian traffic accident fatalities occurred near the EMBL station areas.

summary_ko.method: 2014년 1월부터 2017년 4월까지의 데이터에 따르면, 685건의 보행자 교통사망 사고 중 98건(14%)이 EMBL역 주변에서 발생하였다.
